notes.title: v 0.0.3 Small Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39160308/5e8052dab1fa868350e93aac109b02f42251a080.png[/img]

[h1]Introducing Minerals.[/h1]

Players now able to collect some common , rare and epic minerals from random locations on world. 

* Iron
* Gold
* Diamond
* Tantalum
* Astatine
* Antimatter

With future updates player will use those minerals at repairing wonders , upgrading technologies and some other features.

notes.title: Wonder Defense: Chapter Earth Released as Early Access
notes.content:
Today, I released my first game on Steam that I have been working for 4 months. I hope you will like it. You can access the to-do list for the game on the [url=https://trello.com/b/faym1pZt/wondersroadmap] Trello page [/url]
Follow [url=https://twitter.com/DefenseWonder] Wonder Defense [/url] on Twitter
 [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMzdSa2DUmW9XUEm1Lsm9cA]Subscribe[/url] our Youtube channel.

Thank you for playing.

Arif Akca
Developer
